subject: AI meal tag suggestions via ✨ button (scoped, ready to build)
description: DISCUSSED 2026-06-04, decisions made. Build: a ✨ 'Suggest tags' button next to the tag chip row on the meal form, drink form, and edit form in Meals.razor. Tap -> Gemini call (new GeminiAnalyzer method, reuse GenerateAsync) with description + portion note + meal type; response pre-selects chips from the known vocabulary and may propose AT MOST 1 new tag, rendered as a visually distinct 'proposed' chip the user must tap to accept (prompt strongly prefers existing vocabulary to limit drift). Accepted custom tags join the chip row for future entries (chips = fixed 7 + distinct tags already used in the DB). Nothing is applied without the user seeing it before save. Fallback when no key/offline/API error: a small static keyword map (protein foods -> High protein, restaurant/chain names -> Restaurant meal + High sodium, sweet drinks -> Sweet drink, etc.) fills what it can via the same button — fallback only, not a parallel always-on system. Save stays instant; no background or batch tagging (rejected: auto-on-save, daily-batch).
